top_signals.title: Huang Out: Nvidia boss resigns over affairs
top_signals.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia chief executive after 33 years at the helm, following revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. The departure brings an extraordinary end to the reign of one of Silicon Valley’s most influential figures, who transformed Nvidia into the chipmaker powering the [...]

top_signals.summary: British Airways is being sued by an American passenger for more than £50,000 after she fell and fractured her leg while disembarking a plane at Heathrow. According to documents filed in the High Court, Melissa Phillips, who was travelling back to Maryland in the US, where she lives, from Israel via Heathrow, suffered fractures in [...]

top_signals.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
top_signals.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in 2027. At a forecast 505,000 b/d in 2027, output would be the most since 2014.
